title: Open a running agent's conversation and list finished agents from the task strip
notes: The Claude screen shows running agents, workflows and background commands in its task strip (src/shared/chat/chat-tasks.ts), and each subagent's steps fold into the Agent call that started it. Missing: (1) opening a strip row to read that agent's full conversation so far (its steps, tool calls and results, rendered like the main transcript, live while it runs); (2) a list of agents and workflows that already finished this conversation, with their result summary, tokens and time, reachable from the strip or a key. Keyboard first: a key focuses the strip, arrows walk it, Enter opens the agent's view, Escape returns. Help and docs/chat updated; the shaping of finished tasks is a tested module.

comments.body: Also, from the user (2026-11-05), as Claude Code shows them: subagent tokens. (1) Each Agent/Task tool call in the conversation shows its agent's tokens, tool count and time, live while it runs and kept after it finishes (from task_progress usage.total_tokens, already read by chat-tasks.ts, and the task's final usage). (2) The working line's '↓ N tokens' includes subagent output, the gap PR #212 left (main drops subagent stream events; relay their message_delta usage or add the task totals). Check the numbers against Claude Code on the same prompt and put both in the PR.
